0022600103.text: The Trail Blazers (1-0, first in the Northwest and first in the West) are on the road for their second game of the season, while the Sacramento Kings (0-1, fourth in the Pacific and 14th in the West) are looking for their first win. Portland is without Branden Carlson (concussion) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk (ankle soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Portland won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series, including a 122-110 win in Portland on April 12, 2026, and no games have been played yet between the teams this season.
